say:1:1130955001:1.text: I just wanna go back to where I was born.
say:1:1130955001:1.source_cn: 我、我要回到我出生的地方。

say:2:1130955002:1.text: It's too dangerous here! The people of Alkali and the nearby clans would never take me in.
say:2:1130955002:1.source_cn: 这里太危险了！咸水镇的人……还有周围的部落，都绝对不会...

say:3:1130955003:1.text: I was tricked into being a Claw in the first place! Plus, maybe my family has been looking for me!
say:3:1130955003:1.source_cn: 而且，我是被骗进流沙之爪的！说不定，我的家人还一直在找我！

say:4:1130955004:1.text: But I'd have to ditch this outfit before I get back...
say:4:1130955004:1.source_cn: 不过，在回去之前，我得先把这身衣服换掉才行……
